research_focus: Mission loss in service-minutes; dependency uncertainty and correlated failures
interpretation: q_f(t) is delivered fraction in [0,1]; weights w_f sum to one; T and integral use minutes. Compare architectures at equal demand and recovery staffing.
baselines: Static asset tiers; independent-component availability; graph with no common-cause node
schema: Typed service inventory, dependency confidence, demand trace, failover delay, repair duration, scenario identifier
graduate_challenges: Missing dependencies; dependence between repairs; operator interventions; topology uncertainty
stress_tests: Shared power or identity failure; delayed failover; demand burst; undocumented edge
metrics: Recovery loss difference, time to essential function, 95% interval, model calibration
resources: Discrete-event model, graph inventory, one workstation, systems engineer and independent mission owner

research_focus: Invariant preservation and refinement between specification and implementation
equation: G(authorized AND fresh AND valid -> permitted) AND G(NOT authorized -> NOT permitted)
interpretation: G is the temporal always operator. This is an illustrative policy, not a complete security property; prove freshness and authorization predicates separately. Model liveness under explicit fairness assumptions.
baselines: Unit tests alone; syntax-only change gate; unbounded optimistic state machine
schema: State, transition, decision, policy revision, proof assumption, expected outcome, tool version
graduate_challenges: State explosion; abstraction unsoundness; undefined behavior; fairness mistaken for a guarantee
stress_tests: Concurrent revocation; crash during transition; overflow at schema boundary; reordered benign events
metrics: Reachable invariant violations, explored states, trace length, proof coverage, runtime overhead
resources: TLA+ or an equivalent model checker, bounded reference interpreter, developer and formal-methods reviewer

research_focus: Recoverable device state across interruptions and physical environmental changes
equation: P_safe = sum_s P(s) I[invariant holds after recovery(s)]
interpretation: s indexes a documented fault schedule. Probabilities are assumed until measured; enumerate cut points rather than claiming a physical radiation upset distribution.
baselines: Single-slot update; checksums without versioned state; no cross-sensor redundancy
schema: Update stage, verified version, active slot, power condition, temperature, sensor residual, recovery state
graduate_challenges: Atomicity across reset; boot dependency; drift vs fault discrimination; measurement probe loading
stress_tests: Reset at every update boundary; loss of metadata write; benign sensor drift; recovery image unavailable
metrics: Recoverability fraction, boot latency, flash wear, energy and independent trusted-image availability
resources: Owned development board or emulator, current-limited supply, logic analyzer; no invasive extraction or bypass methods

research_focus: Evidence freshness and transitive component dependence
equation: E(a,t) = sum_j alpha_j I[e_j binds artifact a AND is current at t]
interpretation: alpha_j are declared decision weights, not empirical trust probabilities. Keep authenticity, reproducibility, vulnerability relevance and maintainer continuity as separate axes.
baselines: Flat component count; unsigned inventory; latest package name match
schema: Artifact digest, package ecosystem and version, dependency edge, builder identity, provenance predicate, evidence expiry
graduate_challenges: Namespace collisions; incomplete dependency graph; provenance verifier trust; version range ambiguity
stress_tests: Stale SBOM; missing build link; renamed package; optional dependency; identical name in different ecosystems
metrics: Evidence completeness, false acceptance, reproducibility rate, remediation lead time
resources: SPDX/CycloneDX parser, provenance verifier and owned builds; public metadata snapshots

research_focus: Partial observation under time uncertainty, benign drift and rare-event prevalence
interpretation: x is an aggregate count or scalar; freeze training window and threshold before testing. MAD needs an explicit zero-scale fallback. Correlated samples invalidate naive per-row confidence intervals.
baselines: Fixed global threshold; rolling mean/std; single-sensor detector
schema: Event time, ingest time, sensor pseudonym, aggregation interval, event count, missingness mask, maintenance label
graduate_challenges: Nonrandom missingness; time skew; base-rate collapse; legitimate operating change
stress_tests: Drop sensor blocks; change benign mean; burst legitimate demand; skew clocks; lower anomaly prevalence
metrics: Precision-recall, false alerts per sensor-hour, event detection delay, missingness-conditioned recall
resources: Offline LANL aggregates or owned OpenTelemetry traces; no live scanning or packet injection

research_focus: Observation validity and intervals of event ordering
interpretation: Infer A before B only when upper(A)<lower(B); overlapping intervals are indeterminate. A timeline order does not establish cause. Acquisition errors remain separate from clock errors.
baselines: Sort timestamps directly; assume absent record means event absent
schema: Artifact digest, source, acquisition version, observation window, timestamp bound, chain-of-custody step, known fixture truth
graduate_challenges: Unsynchronized clocks; duplicated events; destructive acquisition; unsupported negative inference
stress_tests: Known clock offsets; partial acquisitions; duplicate records; missing log interval; parser version changes
metrics: Ordering accuracy, indeterminate fraction, evidence reproducibility, traceable inference rate
resources: NIST CFReDS fixture selection; synthetic evidence first; read-only analysis with pinned tools

research_focus: Authority propagation, revocation and minimal disclosure
equation: min sum_p c_p x_p subject to required_actions subseteq authorized(x)
interpretation: x_p is a binary permission choice; constraints encode task needs, incompatible roles and grant provenance. Define denial cost separately; the cheapest policy is not automatically the safest.
baselines: Role template; permission union; periodic access review
schema: Actor pseudonym, resource class, task requirement, grant origin, expiry, revocation time, decision reason
graduate_challenges: Context drift; exception authority; consent vs authentication confusion; indirect entitlement
stress_tests: Revoked delegator; expired exception; changing task; partial federation outage; stale cache
metrics: Excess permissions, task success, denial rate, revocation latency p95, explanation completeness
resources: Synthetic authorization graph, integer solver optional, identity owner and privacy reviewer

research_focus: Declarative state, failure domains and recovery constraints
equation: J = sum_f w_f downtime_f + lambda sum_r recovery_cost_r
interpretation: Separate hard residency, key-availability and consistency constraints from tradeable costs. Model correlated zonal and identity outages instead of multiplying independent availability estimates.
baselines: Single-region restore; periodic snapshot success; configuration diff without resource lineage
schema: Resource pseudonym, desired and observed state, region class, backup digest, restore dependency, recovery duration
graduate_challenges: Eventual consistency; ephemeral identities; backup key coupling; portability vs fidelity
stress_tests: Stale snapshot; identity unavailable; region unavailable; inconsistent dependency checkpoint
metrics: Restore success, data-loss window, recovery loss, state-diff precision, recovery resource demand
resources: Google Borg traces for workload timing only; synthetic cloud control-plane and owned isolated restores

research_focus: Calibrated decisions, abstention and evidence traceability
equation: Brier = mean_i (p_i-y_i)^2; utility = TP b - FP c - abstentions a
interpretation: Probabilities must come from an independently calibrated model. Thresholds optimize declared decision costs on validation data only; utility weights require owner elicitation and sensitivity analysis.
baselines: Rule-based queue; uncalibrated model; always-abstain policy; same model without evidence check
schema: Case identifier, time split, evidence availability, score, label provenance, recommendation, human outcome
graduate_challenges: Temporal leakage; unsupported explanations; selective labels; workload-dependent intervention
stress_tests: Missing evidence; contradictory sources; benign drift; unseen channel; reduced prevalence
metrics: Brier score, risk vs coverage, unsupported assertion rate, false-alert budget, human correction cost
resources: Offline curated cases and public telemetry; model output is analysis advice with bounded authority

research_focus: Physical consistency and safety constraints during service degradation
equation: x_(t+1)=A x_t+B u_t+w_t; y_t=C x_t+v_t; r_t=y_t-C xhat_t
interpretation: State units and sample period are explicit. Residuals indicate disagreement with the model; they do not prove malicious behavior. Add actuator and safe-set constraints before controller use.
baselines: Range limits; independent sensor thresholds; persistence predictor
schema: Time, physical state, sensor value, calibration uncertainty, mode, declared safe set, maintenance flag
graduate_challenges: Model mismatch; legitimate maintenance; actuator saturation; unobservable states
stress_tests: Sensor loss; biased calibration; changed load; delayed sample; infeasible recovery state
metrics: Residual calibration, false alarms per hour, safe-set violations, essential throughput
resources: Offline physical simulator; domain-qualified safety review before any bench actuation

research_focus: Time-varying contact, trustworthy state and finite onboard resources
equation: A_(t+1)=0 if verified contact else A_t+dt; delivery iff contact AND evidence_valid
interpretation: A is age of information in seconds. Reset only on verified reception of a newer state. Include clock uncertainty, key expiry, storage limits and intermittent power in extensions.
baselines: Always-connected policy; transmit-at-every-step scheduler; unverified receipt
schema: Relative mission time, contact flag, queue bytes, evidence age, power mode, verified digest, rollback state
graduate_challenges: Availability vs freshness; cosmic faults vs software faults; limited energy; no trusted wall clock
stress_tests: Missed contact; delayed receipt; key expiry in blackout; storage full; reset during staging
metrics: Verified delivery fraction, age p95, energy proxy, recovery latency, evidence storage
resources: NASA cFS source as architecture study; synthetic contacts, emulated payload; passive RF resources only

research_focus: Human judgment under constrained time, attention and accessible presentation
equation: E[cost]=sum_k P(outcome_k) cost_k; workload = arrival_rate * handling_time
interpretation: Use task and participant as separate effects. A shorter response time is not an improvement if error severity rises; report accessibility and workload strata.
baselines: Existing interface; unprioritized queue; single handoff template
schema: Consented participant pseudonym, task, randomized condition, error severity, timing, accessibility need class
graduate_challenges: Learning carryover; assessor bias; team interference; small samples
stress_tests: High alert load; shift turnover; ambiguous evidence; accessible alternative needed
metrics: Decision accuracy, severe error fraction, task time, cognitive workload, handoff loss
resources: Consented tabletop study, blinded rubric, task-balanced crossover; no deceptive campaigns

research_focus: Recovery precedence, reversibility and mission demand
interpretation: Every repair uses finite staff and prerequisites; the simple serial model is a lower-fidelity reference. Treat safety approvals, rollback and uncertain repair times as first-class constraints.
baselines: FIFO repair; shortest-repair-first; static asset criticality
schema: Failure scenario, dependency edges, repair interval, staffing, decision authorization, restored function
graduate_challenges: Unknown prerequisites; repair-time heavy tails; competing mission priorities; operator handoff
stress_tests: Unavailable backup; hidden dependency; staff loss; interrupted restore; false-positive containment
metrics: Weighted loss, repair regret, rollback success, recovery time, resource utilization
resources: Offline schedules, sanitized past incidents only if authorized; no automatic production response

research_focus: Temporal evidence about relevance and remediation, with censored outcomes
interpretation: Hazard model is proposed. Inclusion in KEV is a selected positive observation, not a random sample or proof that all other entries are safe. Control publication and addition dates as separate processes.
baselines: Age-only prioritization; severity-only ranking; manual owned inventory join
schema: CVE identifier, catalog addition date, publication date if separately acquired, owned inventory relevance, remediation status
graduate_challenges: Selection bias; right censoring; incorrect version join; catalog date vs exploitation date
stress_tests: Ambiguous inventory match; unknown remediation date; late publication; vendor naming variation
metrics: Relevance precision, exposure-days, matched-record coverage, right-censor fraction
resources: Public CISA metadata plus synthetic owned inventory; no discovery of third-party assets

research_focus: Identifiable outcomes and robust resource choices
interpretation: ATE is identifiable only with justified assignment/ignorability, overlap and interference assumptions. Value of information is model-dependent; do not turn an expert weight into a measured probability.
baselines: Unadjusted before/after comparison; maturity self-rating; point-estimate budget
schema: Outcome definition, intervention time, exposure denominator, covariates, cost, uncertainty, missingness reason
graduate_challenges: Confounding; metric gaming; rare events; correlated controls; nonstationary environment
stress_tests: Changed collection pipeline; concurrent intervention; lower event rate; adverse subgroup
metrics: Effect interval, calibration, cost per retained service-minute, sensitivity to assumptions
resources: Preregistered longitudinal design, offline counterfactual simulations, independent measurement reviewer
